title: Yesterday's build integrated and merged branches cleaned
statement: 13 PRs from the dated build work were merged across Open Presence, Observstory and Knowledge Lab. 36 merged branches were deleted after exact-head, dependency and merge checks. Four local app screens render without JavaScript errors. The NUC installed runtime is not verified by local screenshots. See the report for tests and remaining work.
conditions: The checked-in context packet is historical; current GitHub and local source were inspected directly.
Merging a proposal file does not record human acceptance.
Local screenshots do not prove NUC deployment.
